name: Fran
source:
“Ah! You shine with the beauty of the goddess Kalia herself!”

A lighthearted third son of a noble family, encountered by chance.
With his upbeat personality, Fran often lifts the heroine’s spirits, offering her warmth and comfort in her darkest moments.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
